resources.name: Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE)

access.notes: Open-source Python package for atomic-scale simulations.

resources.notes: Used for setting up the Cu(211) slab and running DFT calculations.

resources.name: Dacapo DFT code

access.notes: Legacy DFT code; any code capable of RPBE with ultrasoft pseudopotentials (e.g., GPAW, Quantum ESPRESSO) is an acceptable alternative.

resources.notes: Original DFT code used in the paper; not strictly required but provides the reference setup.

resources.name: Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials (RPBE)

access.notes: Available with Dacapo distribution or from pseudo-dojo (http://www.pseudo-dojo.org/).

resources.notes: Required for the RPBE functional as used in the paper.

access.notes: Standard fcc Cu lattice constant (3.615 Å) from CRC Handbook; the (211) surface is reconstructable from bulk coordinates.

resources.name: Standard thermodynamic data (CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics)

access.notes: Standard reference for free energies of formation needed for the aqueous methanediol derivation. NIST Webbook data can also be used.

resources.notes: Provides experimental free energies of CO2(g), H2O(l), etc. required to derive the free energy of H2C(OH)2(aq).
